chunks: Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja‘far عليه السلام was asked about a man for whom, when he performs wudu (ablution), a spot remains on his face that the water did not reach, so he said:
"It suffices him to moisten it from some part of his body."

key_terms.جَسَدِهِ: his body, meaning another moist part of it
key_terms.مَوْضِعٌ: a spot or area left unwashed

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if a small spot on the face remains dry during wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding wudu (ablution) when a small spot on the face is left dry. Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that it is sufficient to moisten that area using moisture from another part of the body, indicating facilitation in completing ritual purity.
